capture.heading: Capture & upload defaults
capture.explainer: Applied to new notes and uploads. You can still override either per upload.
capture.scopeHelp: Shared memories become visible to your organization (full org sharing lands in a later session).

discard.label: Extract and discard by default
discard.help: Delete the original file after its facts are extracted. Keep only the verified memories. Nothing durable is stored; the derived memories retain full provenance.

profile.heading: Profile & context
profile.explainer: Tells Cogeto who you are, which timezone your days run in, and which language it should speak. These are settings, not memories: they shape phrasing and interpretation, and are never cited as facts.
profile.name: Your name
profile.aboutWorkPlaceholder: One line, e.g. fractional CTO work for industrial SMEs
profile.languageHelp: The interface, the digest and everything Cogeto starts on its own speak this language. Replies mirror the language you write in.
profile.qualityNote: Interface language is not extraction quality. Memory quality is measured per language. Measured today: {{measured}}. Interface only, with no measured quality claim for facts extracted in them: {{unmeasured}}.

strict.label: Always answer in my language
strict.help: Replies come back in your preferred language no matter which language you asked in.

suggestion.company: It looks like you work at {{value}} <src>(from your {{source}} of {{date}})</src>. Use as context?
suggestion.role: It looks like your role is {{value}} <src>(from your {{source}} of {{date}})</src>. Use as context?

appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.explainer: Dark is the default. Your choice is remembered on this device and applies everywhere.

research.heading: Web research
research.explainer: When Cogeto can't answer from your memory, it can check the web. The sent query and the sources it read are always shown and recorded in provenance.

auto.label: Research automatically
auto.help: Skip the prompt: when an answer needs the web, Cogeto searches and reads the most relevant sources on its own. Off by default, so nothing leaves without your tap.

models.heading: Model configuration
models.explainer: Read-only. Which providers and models this instance uses, and what leaves it. API keys are never shown here.
models.notConfigured: no model provider is configured, model features are off until one is added under Providers
models.managedIn: Providers, assignments and the models people may choose are all set there.

externalCalls.unconfigured: No model provider is configured, so nothing leaves this instance for model calls; model features are disabled.
externalCalls.allLocal: Model calls (including embeddings) go to the local Ollama runtime on your own network; nothing is sent to a hosted model provider.
externalCalls.redacted: Model calls (including embeddings) go to {{providers}}; redaction pseudonymizes the text before it leaves this instance and fails closed if the sidecar is down.
externalCalls.external: Model calls (including embeddings) send text to {{providers}}; everything else stays inside this instance.

aliases.heading: Entity aliases
aliases.explainer: Two names for the same thing pair for contradiction checks, including a Croatian and an English name for one company.
aliases.canonicalPlaceholder: The name your documents use most
aliases.aliasPlaceholder: Another name for the same thing

signingKey.heading: Instance signing key
signingKey.explainer: Every deletion receipt is signed with this instance's private key (spec §11.1). Anyone can verify a receipt or the Forgotten ledger against the public key below, proof that a deletion really happened, independent of Cogeto.
